verdict.rationale: Thoropass has access-review automation that validates access changes and reminds admins per policy timelines (docs-4, docs-5, docs-30, docs-32), which covers part of the 'leaver lost access' compliance check, but there is no evidence of HR-system sync, automated onboarding/training-completion tracking, or a unified onboard/offboard checklist tied to hire/termination events. Missing for 10: HR system integration/sync, training-completion verification tied to onboarding, explicit offboarding checklist triggered by termination events.
